oil.when: 2018 (service interval shown in the instrument cluster; two cluster types)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
Switch the ignition on and bring up the service interval (Service in) display in the instrument cluster.
Cluster with a RESET button: press and hold RESET for more than 1 second.
Cluster with an OK button: press and hold OK for more than 1 second.
The countdown restarts at the miles and days that were set before. Switch off and on again and check the Service message is gone.
oil.note: Checked in the 2018 Rio owner's manual. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected, the fuse switch turned off, or the battery run flat.
